ns2:section.sectionText: This class is an exploration of the sectors of industry, government, and healthcare that span the professional field of Bioengineering. The objective is for students to gain introductor knowledge of how the ecosystem is organized, how it is changing, how sectors interact, and the categories of jobs within each sector. Students will personally interview professionals across the ecosystem to develop interaction maps and to address self-driven inquries. The course is designed for second year undergraduate students in Bioengineering.
